6a6aa8e25ce77038f78f5360 description:
You know, sometimes I get bored watching my people's bodycams and whatever network is still up in Tarkov, and I decide to hack into any vulnerability just to see what's going on.

Do you know Lotus? She's a big trader here in Tarkov, and she has a lot of people too. From the data we have on her, she's more connected to Russia as a whole, RUAF, and their allies.

Well, that doesn't matter much right now. What matters is that I intercepted some signals, and it seems a few Raiders managed to eavesdrop on a broadcast from Lotus to some of her mercenaries. That ended up leaking the location of one of her stashes on Woods.

Even if I offered help, she'd hardly accept it. So head over to Reserve and plant some Jammers on those two main antennas near the tents and the helicopter. That will make them stop listening in on other people's conversations.
